sources.title: simaai/LFM2-VL-450M-Autoround-Safetensors · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a post-training quantized version of LiquidAI/LFM2-VL-450M, prepared as a Hugging Face checkpoint for LLiMa compilation and Sima.ai deployment. The source model's license and use restrictions continue to apply.

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2-VL-450M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A newer version of this model is available: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M

sources.title: LFM2-VL-450M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: LFM2-VL-450M is Liquid AI's smallest vision-language model, designed for edge deployment with strict memory and compute constraints. Delivers fast multimodal inference on resource-limited devices.

sources.title: LFM2.5-VL-450M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: Compact 450M vision-language model with enhanced performance for edge deployment ← Back to Vision Models LFM2.5-VL-450M is Liquid AI's smallest vision-language model, building on LFM2-VL-450M with extended reinforcement learning for improved performance while maintaining the same compact deployment footprint.

sources.title: LFM2-VL: Efficient Vision-Language Models | Blog | Liquid AI
sources.snippet: Today we release LFM2-VL, our first vision-language models, built for low-latency, device-aware text and image use.
